entities.summary: Me'ilah is a tractate of Seder Kodashim in the Mishnah, Tosefta, and Babylonian Talmud. It deals chiefly with the exact provisions of the law concerning the trespass-offering and the reparation which must be made by one who has used and enjoyed a consecrated thing.
